brief.angle: An AI model cannot spell check 'strawberry' because it never reads single letters.
brief.measure: How text tokenizers split words into numbers before an AI sees them.
brief.calc: Word 'strawberry' -> tokenized into two integer IDs ('straw' + 'berry') -> zero individual letter representations sent to model layers.
brief.why_now: Explains the fundamental mechanical flaw behind everyday AI counting errors.

problems: 10 statements need a web check, but web search is unavailable right now, so nothing can be verified. Use only numbers you derive by arithmetic, or leave the statements out

spec.title: An AI cannot spell check strawberry because it reads tokens
spec.summary: AI models cannot reliably count letters in words like strawberry because tokenization converts text into subword integer IDs before model processing.

beats.say: An A I model cannot spell check the word strawberry.
beats.cap: An AI cannot spell check strawberry.

beats.say: It does not see letters when reading your text.
beats.cap: It does not see letters when reading text.

beats.say: A tokenizer cuts text into chunk numbers first.
beats.cap: A tokenizer cuts text into chunk numbers first.

beats.say: The main A I model only receives integer I D s.
beats.cap: The main AI model only receives integer IDs.

beats.say: A tokenizer splits strawberry into two parts.
beats.cap: A tokenizer splits strawberry into 2 parts.

beats.say: The segment straw becomes one token number.
The segment berry becomes a second token number.
The model receives two numbers instead of ten letters.
beats.cap: Model gets 2 numbers instead of 10 letters.

beats.say: Counting R letters is like guessing pages in a closed book.
beats.cap: Counting R letters is like guessing pages in a closed book.

beats.say: So the model guesses spelling from memory pattern frequency.
beats.cap: The model guesses spelling from pattern frequency.

beats.say: It fails on spelling homework because individual letters never entered its code.
beats.cap: Individual letters never entered its code.

beats.say: Processing two tokens instead of ten letters shortens the sequence length by eighty percent.
